title: Mathlib's Intermediate Value Theorem, imported (labeled scaffolding, not ours)
statement: The proposition Mathlib states as intermediate_value_Icc: for a conditionally complete densely ordered linear order alpha with the order topology, a linear order delta with an order-closed topology, a <= b, and f continuous on [a,b], the interval [f a, f b] is a subset of f's image of [a,b]. Imported as Mathlib's own statement and proof term, not established by this project -- see proof_route.
